title: Feedback trails (echo / smear)
description: Classic TOP feedback loop that leaves fading trails behind a moving source.
acceptance: trails fade out instead of saturating to white
steps:
1. Source: any moving TOP (e.g. noiseTOP with an absTime-driven offset/translate, or a moving circleTOP) named src.
2. feedbackTOP named fb_in, input = src (input only sets resolution/reset).
3. compositeTOP named fb_mix with inputs [src, fb_in], operation add or over.
4. levelTOP named fb_fade after fb_mix: lower opacity/brightness slightly (0.9-0.97) so trails decay.
5. transformTOP named fb_transform after fb_fade: tiny scale (1.005-1.02) and/or rotate for drifting trails.
6. nullTOP named fb_end after fb_transform. Set fb_in Target TOP parameter to fb_end.
7. nullTOP out1 after fb_end.
Use operator_info for the exact names of: composite operation menu, level opacity/brightness, transform scale/rotate, feedback target TOP.
Tune: decay (fb_fade), drift (fb_transform), source speed.
author: kontext.
